blocks.body:
name = "acme/clock-bad-8"
version = "1.0.0"
[agent]
timeout = "30m"
network = "none"

[sandbox]
timezone = "America/New_York"
clock = { start = "2026-03-14T09:00:00-04:00", enforce = "preload" }

[verifier.sandbox]
clock = { start = "2026-03-14T09:00:00-04:00", enforce = "vm" }

diagnostics.message: [verifier.sandbox] takes no clock: the clock covers the agent's and the oracle's phases and the task's services, never grading. The verifier receives TASKMD_CLOCK_START, TASKMD_CLOCK_HANDOFF, and TASKMD_TIMEZONE instead
